videos.script: The insurer liked the questionnaire. So it is sending an auditor, in November. {{auditor}} An auditor does not read answers. An auditor asks to see them. {{see}} Every yes needs something behind it that somebody can check. {{check}} Today you draw the scope on the model, so both sides mean the same thing. {{scope}} You learn what counts as evidence, and why asking someone is the weakest kind. {{evidence}} You read the model's own git history the way an auditor would, including what it cannot prove. {{git}} And you check the request list before the auditor does. Two of the eight items have a problem. {{gaps}} Finding them in October is preparation. Finding them in November is a finding. {{finding}}
